# CoinGlass

> Professional crypto market intelligence platform providing real-time derivatives data, liquidity analytics, and institutional-grade APIs for traders and analysts.

CoinGlass offers comprehensive cryptocurrency market data including futures, spot, options, and ETF tracking across major exchanges like Binance and CME. The platform combines advanced charting tools, liquidation heatmaps, order flow analysis, and technical indicators to serve both retail and institutional traders.

## Key Topics

- Real-time market data
- Open interest tracking
- Liquidation heatmaps
- Funding rates
- Order flow analysis
- Derivatives trading
- Bitcoin (BTC) & Ethereum (ETH)
- Perpetual futures
- Technical indicators (RSI)
- Liquidity analysis
- Crypto API
- Altcoin season index
- ETF fund flows
- Institutional-grade data
- Exchange rankings

## Core Trading Platforms

- [CoinGlass Pro Dashboard](https://www.coinglass.com/pro): Interactive crypto analytics dashboard with market metrics, real-time charts, and professional trading tools
- [CoinGlass Legend](https://legend.coinglass.com): Advanced trading platform featuring liquidity heatmaps, order flow visualization, and professional footprint charts
- [CoinGlass Homepage](https://www.coinglass.com): Main platform providing professional crypto market data, derivatives analytics, and order depth visualization

## Market Data & Analytics

- [Open Interest Tracker](https://www.coinglass.com/open-interest/BTC): Bitcoin and crypto open interest tracking across Binance, CME, and major exchanges with real-time updates
- [Funding Rate Analysis](https://www.coinglass.com/FundingRate): Bitcoin and crypto funding rate comparison and analysis across perpetual futures exchanges
- [Liquidation Heatmaps](https://www.coinglass.com/liquidations): Real-time Bitcoin liquidation heatmaps and cryptocurrency liquidation tracking with visual intensity mapping
- [Crypto Futures Volume](https://www.coinglass.com/pro/futures/Cryptofutures): Crypto futures trading volume and open interest charts with real-time market activity visualization
- [RSI Heatmap](https://www.coinglass.com/pro/i/RsiHeatMap): Crypto market RSI heatmap tracking overbought and oversold zones across cryptocurrencies
- [Top Gainers & Losers](https://www.coinglass.com/gainers-losers): Real-time crypto gainers and losers tracking with price changes and market movement analysis

## Indices & Specialized Metrics

- [CoinGlass Derivatives Index (CGDI)](https://www.coinglass.com/pro/i/CGDI): Global crypto derivatives market index tracking BTC, ETH, SOL, and other major assets
- [Altcoin Season Index](https://www.coinglass.com/pro/i/alt-coin-season): Altcoin Season Index measuring top 100 altcoins performance relative to Bitcoin dominance
- [Bitcoin ETF Fund Flows](https://www.coinglass.com/etf/bitcoin): Bitcoin ETF tracker with fund flows, inflows, outflows, and holdings data across spot Bitcoin ETFs

## Exchange Data & Rankings

- [Exchange Rankings](https://www.coinglass.com/exchanges): Top cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges ranked by trading volume, fees, and user experience metrics

## API & Developer Reference

- [Crypto Data API](https://www.coinglass.com/CryptoApi): Institutional-grade Crypto API V4 with tick-by-tick order books, futures, spot, options, and ETF data
- [API Pricing Plans](https://www.coinglass.com/pricing): CoinGlass API subscription plans for institutional-grade market data with L2 and L3 order book access
